observations.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
observations.justification: The malware string 'ShellExecuteW' was found in the binary. This string is characteristic of Command and Scripting Interpreter behavior. The presence of this specific string alone (no other Command and Scripting Interpreter-related string corroborates it) indicates the malware has capabilities associated with this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.
